What comes after the Universe? The Earth and its place in the Solar System.

In Lecture 2 of the GS Foundation 2028 program, Akhilesh Shrivastava takes Physical Geography forward by exploring the Solar System and the Earth’s place within it.

This lecture builds on the concepts introduced in Lecture 1 and moves closer to understanding the Earth as a planet.

Continue your Physical Geography preparation with Lecture 2 of GS Foundation 2028.
